Context layers
Show the world elevation surface. Models sit on their placed heights either way. Show Esri's Open 3D Buildings layer, built from the Overture Maps buildings theme (OpenStreetMap, Esri Community Maps, Microsoft and Google open buildings), for comparison with the placed models.
Output CRS
EPSG:4979WGS 84 (3D)frame: ENU metres
why EPSG:4979?
The global view's render space is ECEF on a sphere. Anchors are placed into geographic 3D WGS 84 with an east-north-up frame in metres, and the SDK maps those into its render space.

About this demonstrator

This demonstrator tries out the proposed geospatial coordinate reference system support for OpenUSD with Esri products: ArcGIS 3D object layers and the ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript. This page runs OpenUSD compiled to WebAssembly. It reads geo-referenced models whose prims carry a coordinate reference system through the proposed GeospatialCRSBindingAPI, resolves each anchor's CRS, transforms it with a coordinate operation engine plugin (also in WebAssembly) into the view's output CRS in a Hydra scene index, and draws the result with a small WebGL2 pass inside the ArcGIS Maps SDK SceneView.
